notes.sol: Original Study 2A numerical analyses are reported reproduced; unprinted graphical CI endpoints C1/C2 are retired under R6. New C7/C8 use report section 2 plus its explicitly labelled original-outcome cells, not an assertion that the later reconstructed-input run was the shipped workflow. The report's seven-versus-six exclusion criticism has a denominator mismatch: direct evaluation of the pinned UK data finds 7 duplicate rows removed overall, of which 6 have positive num_total_answers (the other has 0). Supplement p.22 describes 6 exclusions among completers; final UK N is 1067. This does not establish a P2 count discrepancy or P3 typo. Audit: model-gating/gold-set/audit/check_g30.R, check_g30_completed.log. C3-C8 references are report-supported, not a new full Study 2A rerun.
notes.claude: Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: Claim list revised: C1/C2 (graphical bootstrap CIs with no printed numbers) were retired, and C7/C8 added. All remaining claims are deterministic (OLS, Welch t, percentage differences) and the report reproduced them exactly ('All analyses were reproducible'). The shipped Study 2 Rmd (SHA matches the pin) has no set.seed for its bootstraps, but that affects only the figure error bars, which are no longer claims. The report's Table 2 is a robustness rerun on recomputed response counts whose values equal the originals; the computational-reproducibility prose is the primary evidence.
